# BRONCHITIS

Acute bronchitis should not be treated with antimicrobials except in specific circumstances. If pneumonia is suspected, order a chest x-ray. If an infiltrate is not present, the patient does not have bacterial pneumonia and need not be treated for it. If a patient has chronic pulmonary disease, see COPD exacerbation menu.
